globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const variant=globalThis.variant ?? 0;
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin: 0; width: 800px; height: 600px;';
  const outer=document.createElement('div');
  outer.style.cssText='display: flex; width: 400px; height: 200px; padding: 10px; margin: 20px; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start;';
  const a=document.createElement('div'),b=document.createElement('div');
  a.style.cssText=`width: ${100+variant}px; height: 50px; flex-shrink: 0;`;
  b.style.cssText='width: 50%; height: 25px; flex-shrink: 0;';
  outer.appendChild(a);outer.appendChild(b);document.body.appendChild(outer);
  const measure=el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x,r.y,r.width,r.height];};
  const eq=(actual,expected)=>actual.every((value,i)=>Math.abs(value-expected[i])<0.0001);
  const initial=eq(measure(outer),[20,20,420,220]) && eq(measure(a),[30,30,100+variant,50]) && eq(measure(b),[140+variant,30,200,25]);
  const snapshot=a.getBoundingClientRect();a.style.marginLeft='5px';
  const live=eq(measure(a),[35,30,100+variant,50]) && eq(measure(b),[145+variant,30,200,25]) && snapshot.x===30;
  a.style.display='none';
  const hidden=eq(measure(a),[0,0,0,0]) && eq(measure(b),[30,30,200,25]);
  b.style.cssText+='position: relative; left: 7px; top: 3px;';
  const relative=eq(measure(b),[37,33,200,25]);
  b.remove();const detached=eq(measure(b),[0,0,0,0]);
  outer.remove();const wrap=document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText='display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 130px; gap: 5px;';
  const items=Array.from({length:3},()=>{const el=document.createElement('div');el.style.cssText='width: 100px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0;';wrap.appendChild(el);return el;});
  document.body.appendChild(wrap);
  const wrapping=eq(measure(wrap),[0,0,130,70]) && items.every((el,i)=>eq(measure(el),[0,i*25,100,20]));
  const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.style.cssText='display: grid; width: 200px; gap: 10px;';
  const first=document.createElement('div'),second=document.createElement('div');first.style.height='20px';second.style.height='30px';
  grid.appendChild(first);grid.appendChild(second);document.body.appendChild(grid);
  const gridAuto=eq(measure(grid),[0,70,200,60]) && eq(measure(first),[0,70,200,20]) && eq(measure(second),[0,100,200,30]);
  const rectangle=new DOMRect(5,6,-10,-20);
  const edges=rectangle.left===-5 && rectangle.right===5 && rectangle.top===-14 && rectangle.bottom===6;
  rectangle.x='8';rectangle.height=30;
  const mutable=rectangle.x===8 && rectangle.bottom===36 && rectangle instanceof DOMRectReadOnly && Object.prototype.toString.call(rectangle)==='[object DOMRect]';
  const copy=DOMRect.fromRect({x:'2',width:'4'});
  const dictionary=copy.x===2 && copy.y===0 && copy.width===4 && copy.height===0 && DOMRect.fromRect(null).x===0 && copy instanceof DOMRect;
  const immutable=new DOMRectReadOnly(1,2,3,4);
  const readonly=immutable.x===1 && Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(DOMRectReadOnly.prototype,'x').set===undefined;
  const brand=(()=>{try{DOMRectReadOnly.prototype.toJSON.call({});return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError;}})();
  const json=JSON.stringify(immutable)==='{"x":1,"y":2,"width":3,"height":4,"top":2,"right":4,"bottom":6,"left":1}';
  const numeric=[1n,Symbol('x'),{valueOf(){return 1n;}}].every(value=>{try{new DOMRect(value);return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError;}});
  const special=new DOMRect(1,2,NaN,NaN);
  const nan=[special.top,special.left,special.bottom,special.right].every(Number.isNaN);
  Object.defineProperty(immutable,'top',{value:500});
  const nativeJSON=immutable.toJSON().top===2;
  const descriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(DOMRectReadOnly.prototype,'x').enumerable;
  return {initial,live,hidden,relative,detached,wrapping,gridAuto,edges,mutable,dictionary,readonly,brand,json,numeric,nan,nativeJSON,descriptor};
})();
